## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school through their favorite picturesque paths while discussing their classmates, including the newly returned [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). During school, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fly into a rage and smash her slate over his head. As punishment, Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to stand in front of the blackboard for the rest of the day, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) when he apologizes afterward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard and later forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to vow never to return to school. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to go back, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to seek advice from [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off. Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) catches [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imaginary future where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married and leaves her, bringing rare laughter to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic goodbye after Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forbids them from playing together. Consoled by the romantic tragedy of their separation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she receives a warm welcome from her classmates and exchanges secret notes with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Channeling her energy into her studies, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enters a fierce academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), excelling in most subjects despite struggling with geometry.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to let her attend a concert and sleep over at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at Diana's house, accidentally jumping on Diana's formidable [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who is enraged. Learning from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) plans to leave and cancel Diana's music lessons, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels deeply remorseful for causing trouble.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of dainty slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) for Christmas. The local Christmas concert is a tremendous success, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivering outstanding recitations and earning high praise. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's growth and secretly express their deep pride in her performance and future potential.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact the story of [Elaine](../character/elaine.md), floating [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) down the pond in a flat. The boat leaks and sinks, forcing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to cling to a bridge pile until [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her in a dory. After refusing Gilbert's offer of friendship, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reunites with her frantic friends and later reflects with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) on learning not to be overly romantic.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets her ongoing feud with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though the two remain fierce academic rivals as the school year ends. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach next year, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to put away her textbooks for a restful summer. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), learns of Matthew's poor health, and admits to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown up.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a carefree summer outdoors on a doctor's recommendation before resuming her studies in September. Over the course of the school year, she prepares for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination under Miss Stacy's guidance and notices her own personal growth. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) reflect on how tall and mature [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) struggles with her anxieties about passing the upcoming exams.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her classmates travel to town to take the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) under Miss Stacy's guidance. After three nerve-wracking weeks of waiting back home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the published pass list showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the entire island with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and ends the day expressing deep gratitude for her success.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets dressed at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with Diana's help before traveling to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a charity concert. Upon arrival, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels intimidated by the city performers and suffers a brief moment of severe stage fright. Spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience restores her determination, leading to a successful performance, an encore, and praise from the other attendees.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), leading to an emotional farewell at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Upon arriving in town and starting her studies alongside fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students, she settles into her new boarding house. A visit from [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and Ruby reveals news of an Avery scholarship, inspiring [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with ambitious new goals for her future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), forming close friendships with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while maintaining her academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She enjoys visits home and time spent with Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood). As spring arrives and final examinations approach, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects philosophically on her efforts while discussing the upcoming exams and commencement with her friends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers she has won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal. After a celebratory commencement with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and catches up with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Soon after, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) notices Matthew's failing health, learns from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about their savings being tied up in a shaky bank, and shares a quiet, peaceful evening walk with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from an oculist that she must give up reading and sewing to save her failing eyesight, leading her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to give up her college scholarship to stay home, care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and teach at the local school. After learning that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school position for her benefit, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reconciles with him, and they agree to become close friends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road

> On the eve of the school year, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate teaching methods, particularly whether corporal punishment is ever justified. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home, stops to visit Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)—who also doubts her gentle discipline approach—and goes to bed feeling anxious about her first day as a teacher. The next morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and gives her advice before she sets off.
>
> — v2 · IV Different Opinions

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) travel around to canvass for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), collecting subscriptions for repairs to the local hall. Along the way, they encounter various eccentric neighbors, including the pessimistic [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md) and her optimistic sister Catherine, a flustered Mr. Blair whom they help bake a cake, and the excessively neat Mrs. Theodore White.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) neighbors for subscriptions to the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), facing various eccentric and difficult residents. They seize an opportunity at Lorenzo White's house following the birth of his new son and secure a generous five-dollar donation. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) makes one final attempt by visiting Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), though he flatly refuses to contribute.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) chat about their writing, teaching experiences with students like [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), and their ambitions for the future. Later, after [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses the possibility of temporarily taking in the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md).
>
> — v2 · VII The Pointing of Duty

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), truthfulness, and the Village Improvement Society's hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it was accidentally painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. Although the society members are devastated, the incident earns them widespread sympathy from the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), discussing community news and Marilla's improving eyesight. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learn that the twins' uncle cannot take them until autumn, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps correct Davy's funny theological misunderstandings after catching him eating plum jam. Later, at an [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, the members are appalled to learn that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a patent medicine company for advertising, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) fail to persuade him otherwise.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes the school year and meets [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) as she walks to the graveyard to place flowers on Matthew's and Hester Gray's graves. On her way, she converses with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) about his family and imagination. Later, Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on her walk home, where they discuss teaching, ideals, college plans, and the meaning of true friendship.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

> Following the party guests' departure, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a letter explaining that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will not be able to visit. Sitting on the porch at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss handling the broken platter, local gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), and life's disappointments before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant day taking the twins to the shore with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and visiting [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea, reassuring him about his imaginative thoughts. When she returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she helps a jealous [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) with his bedtime prayers and reassures him of her affection. Later at twilight, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) and notices how much [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has grown up.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finish talking with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) before walking down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), where she meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to discuss their ideals and the progress of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to the house and talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her plans for the upcoming day and the return to school.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

> After a newspaper item pokes fun at Uncle Abe's weather predictions, a sudden and devastating severe hail storm hits [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact day predicted. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) weather the storm at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the twins, only to find extensive damage to crops, trees, and windows across the village. Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) grieves the loss of his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as the community takes stock of the destruction.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) expresses her anxiety about [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaving for college and asks if [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has romantic feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) clarifies that she sees [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) only as a friend and describes her romantic ideals, leading to gossip about Ruby Gillis's suitors. Finally, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) fondly recall the beginning of their friendship and reaffirm their devotion to each other.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her two-year term as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolteacher, prompting the local village women to gossip about the town's future, her pupils' love for her, and Stephen Irving's sudden arrival in town. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) and his father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to relay a message to Miss Lavendar. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the message to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where she and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) help a nervous Miss Lavendar prepare for Stephen's arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

> In the weeks leading up to Miss Lavendar's wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays busy helping with preparations and discussing the upcoming romantic events with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) together in the garden, learning of their secret romance. The following evening, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her engagement, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on love, change, and her own dreams for the future.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before heading to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to help Miss Lavendar and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) prepare for the wedding. The wedding ceremony takes place in the garden, attended by guests including Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After seeing the newly married couple off at the station, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) return to lock up the house and share a quiet, romantic moment together.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House
